verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers quantization, hardware backends, CPU/GPU hybrid inference, and general benchmarks, but contains no mention of paged KV-cache memory management, memory-fragmentation avoidance, or concurrent-request capacity optimization (e.g., PagedAttention-style allocators). Missing for 10: any documentation or community evidence of paged/segmented KV cache allocation, benchmarks on concurrent request throughput, or fragmentation-reduction claims.
